text: The photo looks down at a lab bench from a low, close angle. In the foreground, running diagonally from lower left to right, are extruded aluminium profile rails with T-slot grooves and drilled mounting holes. Mounted on them is a white plastic plate assembly holding two circular recessed wells, each appearing empty with no visible liquid, plus a partial third round opening at the lower right. The plate is fixed with several shiny metal bolts and small clear/grey spacer blocks. A white label with a black-and-white square fiducial marker and small printed text is attached to one rail. Behind, on a pale grey work surface, stands a dark metal base plate with two black vertical rods; a blue tape strip and lit LED strips are visible along the back.
